settings.title: Who can register for a wholesale account?
settings.text: Wholesale accounts are available to verified businesses including retailers, boutiques, spas, online stores, interior designers, and gift shops. A valid ABN and resale details is required.

settings.title: What is the minimum order value?
settings.text: The minimum wholesale order value is AUD $350 (excluding GST and freight).

settings.title: How do I apply for a wholesale account?
settings.text: Simply register for wholesale access via our login/register page. Once approved, you’ll receive access to wholesale pricing and ordering.

settings.title: Where are your products manufactured?
settings.text: All Pastel Pines home fragrance products are manufactured in our factory located in South Windsor, NSW, Australia.

settings.title: Do you offer private-label or custom branding?
settings.text: Yes. We specialise in private-label manufacturing for candles, diffusers, room sprays, essential oils, pot pourri and more. Minimum order quantities apply. Please refer to the Private Labelling page on our website for more information.

settings.title: How long will it take to dispatch my order?
settings.text: Our typical lead time is approximately 5-7 working days, depending on product type and order size.

settings.title: Do you supply internationally?
settings.text: Yes. We welcome international wholesale enquiries. Please contact our sales team with your region and requirements.

settings.title: What support do you offer wholesale partners?
settings.text: We provide catalogues, product images, scent descriptions, pricing support, and merchandising guidance to help you present our products to your customers.

settings.title: Need more help?
settings.text:
Our team is here to assist with wholesale enquiries, product details or private-label information.
Email: sales@pastelpines.com Phone: (02) 4577 7111

settings.title: FAQs
What type of wax do you use?
settings.text: We use a soy–vegetable wax blend that is vegan-friendly and provides a clean, even burn.

settings.title: How long do your candles burn?
settings.text:
• 230g candles: approx. 20+ hours
  • 300 g candles: approx. 25+ hours
  • 420g candles: approx. 30+ hours

Burn time may vary depending on fragrance type, environment and usage.

settings.title: What fragrance percentage is in your candles?
settings.text: Generally, our candles contain between 8 – 10% fragrance.

settings.title: What kind of wicks do you use?
settings.text: We use only cotton, lead-free wicks or in some products we use wooden wicks.

settings.title: Are the fragrances safe?
settings.text: We check the documentation for each fragrance to ensure it is safe to use in candles in the specified concentration.

settings.title: How do I burn my candle properly?
settings.text: Please refer to our product usage instructions on each candle product listing.

settings.title: What’s the shelf life of your candles?
settings.text: We claim a 12-month shelf life for candles, after that time the scent may fade or the burn performance may be affected.

settings.title: Are your candles made in Australia?
settings.text: Yes, all candles are blended, poured and finished at our facility in Windsor, NSW.

settings.title: Do you offer private-label candles?
settings.text: Yes. Fragrances, packaging and branding can be customised to suit your business’s needs. Minimum order quantities apply. Please refer to the Private Labelling page on our website for more information.

settings.title: Candle FAQs
How long do your diffusers last?
settings.text:
• 80 mL diffusers: up to 6 weeks
  • 145 mL diffusers: up to 12 weeks
  • 200 mL diffusers: up to 16 weeks

settings.title: What affects a diffuser’s life?
settings.text: Strong airflow, fans or open windows can cause the fragrance to evaporate faster. Placement in a low-draft area will extend longevity.

settings.title: How often should I flip the reeds?
settings.text:
To maintain a consistent fragrance, we recommend flipping the reeds once a week. This refreshes the scent and helps it diffuse evenly. If you prefer a stronger scent or notice it fading, you can flip the reeds more often—every few days works well in larger or drafty spaces.
Tip: Flip reeds over a paper towel or sink to avoid staining surfaces with diffuser oil.

settings.title: What are the ingredients?
settings.text: Our Reed Diffusers are made with high-quality fragrance oils. Most are alcohol-based for optimal scent dispersion.

settings.title: Are your diffusers made locally?
settings.text: Yes, all reed diffusers are produced in-house in Australia.

settings.title: Do you offer private-label diffusers?
settings.text: Yes. Diffusers can be fully customised, including fragrance, bottle type, labelling and packaging. Minimum order quantities apply. Please refer to the Private Labelling page on our website for more information.

settings.title: What is the difference between essential oils and fragrance oils?
settings.text:
Essential oils are natural plant extracts known for their aromatherapy benefits.
Fragrance oils may include natural and synthetic components and are created primarily for their scent performance.

settings.title: How do I use essential oils safely?
settings.text: Please refer to our product usage instructions on each product listing for full guidance. Essential oils should be kept out of reach of children and pets. Do not apply directly to the skin unless properly diluted. For further safety information, always consult the usage instructions provided with your product.

settings.title: Where are your essential oils sourced?
settings.text: Our pure essential oils are sourced globally, with each origin chosen for optimal growing conditions and oil yield. For example, our Lavender Oil is harvested from the cooler climate of Bulgaria, while our Orange Oil comes from Brazil, where citrus thrives. For a full list of sources, please contact sales@pastelpines.com.

settings.title: Do you offer private-label essential oils?
settings.text: Yes. Essential oils are available for private-label. Minimum order quantities apply. Please refer to the Private Labelling page on our website for more information.

settings.title: How long does the scent last?
settings.text: Room spray longevity depends on the fragrance type, room size, and ventilation. Typically, a few sprays will scent a room for several hours.

settings.title: What are the ingredients?
settings.text: Our room sprays are made with high-quality fragrances. They are alcohol-based for optimal scent dispersion.

settings.title: Are your room sprays safe to use on fabrics?
settings.text: Room sprays are designed for use in the air. While some customers use them on linens or soft furnishings, we recommend testing on an inconspicuous area first, as some fragrances may cause staining or discoloration.

settings.title: Are your room sprays made in Australia?
settings.text: Yes, all room sprays are blended, filled, and labelled at our facility in South Windsor, NSW.

settings.title: Do you offer private-label room sprays?
settings.text: Yes. Room sprays can be customised with your choice of fragrance, bottle style, labelling, and packaging. Minimum order quantities apply. Please refer to the Private Labelling page on our website for more information.
